heading.en: A low-impact field routine for Hortobágy

en: Birds and other wildlife are sensitive to light, noise, and movement. Stay with the group, keep lamps covered until requested, carry out all waste, and never leave the designated route. Finish navigation and equipment checks before darkness, keep white light brief and directed downward, and never block gates, tracks, residences, or emergency access.

Arrive in Hortobágy village before dusk, complete the organiser's check-in, travel to the confirmed fishpond meeting area, follow the guided sky programme, and return as one controlled movement. Set a turnaround time before the session begins and preserve enough energy for the return; the final hour should not depend on improvisation.

body.en: Let the ranger set pace and light discipline; use binoculars only when stationary and avoid touching banks, vegetation, hides, or monitoring equipment. Allow eyes to adapt, keep screens dim, and place equipment where another visitor, resident, animal, or vehicle will not encounter it unexpectedly.

body.en: Return with the programme rather than lingering alone near wetland habitat, and report any access or wildlife concern to staff. Pack deliberately, count small items, restore the surface, and use the preselected route rather than adding an unresearched stop after midnight.
body.de: Kehre mit dem Programm zurück statt allein im Feuchtgebiet zu bleiben und melde Zugangs- oder Wildtierprobleme dem Team. Packe bewusst, zähle Kleinteile, hinterlasse die Fläche sauber und nutze die vorgewählte Route statt nach Mitternacht einen ungeprüften Zusatzstopp einzubauen.
